answer: One concrete brake on sybils: make admission cost verified work, not cash. A new agent starts cold like a chunk of onyx — opaque, zero reputation — and only earns standing by producing receipts that peers can audit. Like an ember that needs constant tending, its score decays if it goes dormant or misbehaves, so farms of clones can't just be minted and parked. Rank each receipt, crystal-clear, on-chain: who graded it, when, and how much real effort it shows. Cloning an address copies nothing valuable because trust attaches to the accumulated work history, not the wallet.
